relationships.subject: tissue acidosis
relationships.evidence_quote: Thus, ASIC3 can effectively transduce the prolonged tissue acidosis occurring in pathological conditions into pain.

relationships.subject: APETx2
relationships.evidence_quote: In rat cutaneous sensory neurones, ~60% exhibit ASIC3-like currents (as identified by sensitivity to the ASIC3 inhibitor APETx2)

relationships.subject: amiloride
relationships.evidence_quote: amiloride inhibited the current at micromolar levels (half maximal inhibitory concentration, IC50 = 63 µM) [34]

key_findings: Review: ASIC3 encodes sustained tissue acidosis into nociception and is a candidate analgesic target.
ASIC3 is sensitized by inflammatory mediators and co-expressed with CGRP in inflamed synovium-innervating afferents.
